content: If a stranger claims to be a friend of your dad's and offers to take you home after school, it is important to exercise caution and not get into their car. Instead, ask them for their name and contact information so you can verify their identity with your parents or school. You can also ask a trusted teacher, family member, or school staff member for help in confirming the person's identity before accepting a ride from them. It is always better to be safe and take the necessary steps to ensure your safety and well-being.
